name: Monthly Planning
job: Own monthly customer counts, four weekly recipes, and calculated ingredient demand
incomingHandoff: The manager knows the next period needs a customer-led food plan but has not yet committed its weekly meals.
outgoingHandoff: A saved four-week plan supplies customer demand, weekly output, ingredient requirements, and supplier routing to buying and production.
responsiveBehaviour: Show four weekly meals in four, two, then one column while preserving labels, calculated units, and action order.

layoutContract.containment: Content remains in normal flow with explicit internal padding and no overlap.

surfaceContract.contentSeparation: Content padding does not define primitive bounds.
surfaceContract.rule: No primitive surface is mounted until its semantic owner and edge behavior are chosen.

motionContract.justification: Choose and document a semantic experience before adding movement.
